name: Terraria
description: Vanilla Terraria dedicated server. Creates the world on first start and saves it cleanly on stop.

variables.label: Terraria version
variables.description: The dedicated server release, such as 1.4.5.8. Players need the same version.

variables.label: World name
variables.description: Letters, digits, - and _. Created on first start if it does not exist.

variables.label: World size
variables.description: Only used when the world is first created.

variables.label: Difficulty
variables.description: Only used when the world is first created.

variables.label: World seed
variables.description: Leave blank for a random world. Only used when the world is first created.

notes:
Runs the official dedicated server from terraria.org on the [DeployKit Terraria image](https://github.com/deploykithq/deploykit-game-images/tree/master/images/terraria) (vanilla, no TShock).

- The world is generated on the first start; a large world takes a few minutes. Worlds live in `worlds/`.
- World name, size, difficulty and seed only apply when the world is created.
- The settings on this page are written into `serverconfig.txt` on every start; other keys you add to the file are kept.
- The console takes the server's own commands: `save`, `playing`, `kick <name>`, `say <message>`… Stopping the server sends `exit`, which saves the world first.
